A fenced div with the `.offcanvas` class becomes a sliding panel, and the trigger is written for you.

```markdown
:::: {.offcanvas placement="end" trigger-text="Open the panel"}

# A panel

Written as ordinary markdown.

::::
```

:::: {.offcanvas placement="end" trigger-text="Open the panel"}

# A panel

Written as ordinary markdown, so a [link](https://quarto.org) behaves as it would anywhere else.

---

[Close](#){.btn .btn-secondary bs-dismiss="offcanvas"}

::::

A horizontal rule separates the footer from the body, and `placement` takes `start`, `end`, `top`, or `bottom`.

Set defaults for every panel under `extensions.offcanvas`, and override them per panel.

Full documentation: <https://m.canouil.dev/quarto-offcanvas/>.
